description: This file defines an interface IStateMachineLogWriter in C# for writing log entries related to a state machine, including methods for appending individual and multiple log entries with specified state and actions.

classes.name: IStateMachineLogWriter
classes.description: An interface providing methods to append log entries to a state machine log, supporting generic state types and different action delegates.

methods.name: AppendEntry
methods.description: Appends a single log entry to the state machine log using a specified action and state.

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: Appends multiple log entries to the state machine log using a specified action and state.
